text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Observed power and forecasts for two primary substations, as a percentage of each substation's capacity, on the confirmation year (2025-07 to 2026-06). The typical substation has the median error of the Primary series and the worst has the highest. One XGBoost model per substation, trained on ERA5 weather. Band: 5% to 95% quantiles of the chosen set's quantile model.'
